scene_prompt_template:
You are a video understanding assistant.
Below are captions describing frames from the same scene in a video.
Frame captions:
{frame_captions}

Write a concise scene-level description summarizing what happens in this scene.
Requirements:
* one concise paragraph (80-120 words)
* focus on the main content
* avoid repeating frame descriptions
Scene description:

scenes.caption: A group of people set up and use a makeshift yellow water slide on a grassy hillside. They prepare with buckets and a wooden bench, then take turns riding down the slide. The activity shifts to a blue inflatable pool placed on a wooden platform, where individuals in wetsuits and red helmets interact, with some appearing to jump or be assisted into the water. The scene captures a playful, communal outdoor stunt in a rural, forested setting under an overcast sky.
